verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms AnythingLLM runs locally and stores documents/knowledge on-device (anythingllm-docs-1, anythingllm-docs-2, anythingllm-docs-8), but nothing in the pack describes a user-facing way to inspect, edit, or delete what the assistant has 'remembered', nor confirms the memory/vector store is in an open, human-readable format. No docs or community reports mention memory management UI or file format transparency.
